item.title: Palestinian Santa Claus arrested during Israeli police raid on Christmas party
item.description: A Palestinian man dressed as Santa Claus was arrested by Israeli police during a raid on a Christmas celebration in the northern city of Haifa, according to a Palestinian civil rights group. Officers shut down the event, confiscated sound equipment, and also detained a DJ and a street vendor. Video footage circulating online shows police pushing the men to the ground and handcuffing them as onlookers watched. item.title: Pope Leo urges courage to end Ukraine war in Christmas Eve Mass (his first as pontiff)
item.description: Pope Leo called on Ukraine and Russia to find the "courage" to engage in direct talks to end the war during his first Christmas address as pontiff, delivered to crowds in St. Peter's Square. In his traditional Urbi et Orbi message, the Pope appealed for an end to conflicts worldwide, urging the international community to support dialogue. item.title: Zelensky's wish during Christmas Eve speech: Putin's death? We ask for something greater
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky used his Christmas Eve address to express Ukrainians' deepest wish amid nearly four years of war, saying many silently hope for the demise of Russian President Vladimir Putin, while publicly praying for peace. Referring to a traditional belief that wishes made on Christmas night may come true, Zelensky said: "Today, we all share one dream. And we make one wish, for all of us. item.title: Christmas at Bondi Beach dampened as Australians grieve deadliest mass shooting in nearly 30 years
item.description: Christmas celebrations were subdued at Sydney's iconic Bondi Beach on Thursday as the community mourned the terror attack that killed 15 people during a Jewish Hanukkah event last week, marking Australia's deadliest mass shooting in nearly 30 years. Police patrolled the beachfront as hundreds of people, many wearing Santa hats, gathered in quiet remembrance. item.title: United States launches airstrike on Islamic State militants in Nigeria
item.description: The United States carried out an airstrike against Islamic State militants in northwest Nigeria at the request of the Nigerian government, United States officials said on Thursday.
